cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Apologize to Reality
cards.instruction: Get someone to apologize to an object, rule, place, or idea for violating its impossible expectations.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Welcome to our inn. Please apologise to the doorway for knocking after you arrived.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I had to get here to knock.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. It expected advance notice from your knuckles. Explain that you're sorry.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Sorry, doorway. I did phone ahead.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then apologise for telling the telephone first. It had to hear about its own visitor secondhand.
